title: Chapter 171
text:
After waiting for a few minutes, a man walked into the cafe and sat opposite Han Xiao. He was wrapped in a dark green trench coat, wearing a pair of sunglasses and a hat. A scarf was wrapped around his neck, covering the lower half of his face. The man carried a metal suitcase and placed it on the table. He stared at Han Xiao without saying a word.

The seller knew that the buyer was Black Phantom, but Han Xiao was a stranger.

Han Xiao and the seller stared at each other for a while, confirming each other's identities in silence. Which stranger would not say a word and just stare at each other like idiots? The seller entered the password and opened the briefcase to Han Xiao.

There was a small circular device inside the briefcase. All kinds of wires were exposed to the air, and the structure was complicated. In the middle of the device was a bulging cylinder with a black metal shell. There were red lights flashing in the gaps. This was the Mini Bonfire Reaction Furnace, an energy core that could automatically generate electricity through solar energy and concentrated fuel. It was an advanced energy branch equipment and also a Super equipment. Energy could also be used as fuel to convert into energy.

The self-charging battery could save the trouble of recharging, and it was the core material of a mechanical suit. It would be awkward if he had to change the battery in the middle of the battle.

Han Xiao touched the device and confirmed that it was not a model. He took out his PDA and paid the seller with his Dark Net account. He moved quickly and said, "Run."

Han Xiao did not care about the seller's reaction. He grabbed the Mini Bonfire Reaction Furnace and threw it into his backpack. He then stood up abruptly, took out the Berserk Eagle, aimed at the surveillance target, and fired continuously.

In fact, the moment the transaction was completed, the Ordina agents were ready to attack. However, Han Xiao was one second faster.

The large caliber steel core bullets jumped out of the gun, and the kinetic energy within a few dozen meters was no less than that of a sniper bullet. The few surveillance agents who were hit flew backward.

They were all wearing bulletproof vests and had well-trained bodies, but they were all ordinary soldiers with no energy. Han Xiao was a LV 55 Mechanic, and his gun attributes had been specially enhanced. He also had all kinds of affinity skills that increased the power of machines. One shot was all it took to make these surveillance agents lose their ability to fight, heavily injuring them and making them unable to move.

The seller did not hesitate and immediately smashed through the floor-to-ceiling window. The glass shards fell to the ground. He ran as fast as he could. His movements were nimble, and every step he took covered a few meters. He was also a superhuman.

Han Xiao fled in another direction. Splitting up would allow him to divert the enemy's strength.

"Bastard, who are you dealing with?!" The commander of Ordina was furious. He didn't expect the buyer to be that strong, but he was able to detect the danger in advance. Han Xiao's sudden appearance had messed up the plan. The commander immediately ordered the agents and soldiers to move out. The troops on standby were divided into two groups, one to track the seller and the other Han Xiao.

There was a puddle of water on the street. Han Xiao skimmed past quickly, stirring up a large splash.

Dense footsteps sounded all around him. Agents appeared from alleys and buildings and fired in his direction. The pedestrians on the street screamed and ran for cover.

With the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor on his body, the bullets bounced off, and sparks flew everywhere. Han Xiao had two guns in his hands. While he slid, he shot at the agents who were flipping over, without missing a single shot.

Suddenly, Han Xiao felt a stagnation under his feet. The puddle of water had actually reached his calves and slowed him down.

"The Superhuman agents of Ordina have made their move." Han Xiao's eyes flashed. The information on the interface had already told him the identity of the enemy. It was an Esper around LV 30.

Two Pugilist agents rushed out from the side of the street. While Han Xiao was slowing down, they quickly closed in on him and attacked him with fists and legs wrapped in flames.

Han Xiao's expression did not change as the enemy closed in on him. He activated the Sunworm's [Concentrated Spray]. Thick orange flames shot out from the bottom of his palm and engulfed the two Pugilist agents. The continuous damage was very high. The two Pugilist agents screamed in pain and hurriedly retreated.

The flames mixed with the rainwater and turned into a white mist. The steam even sizzled, blocking the vision of the agents.

Han Xiao activated the full power of his Electromagnetic Hover-boots and shredded all the puddles that clung to him. He retreated at high speed and quickly got out of the range of the Water Manipulation Esper. He did not want to fight with the enemy agents in Ordina's territory.

At this time, the sound of engines suddenly sounded. Two black police cars rushed out from the intersection in front of him. They were rather large and looked like recreational vehicles. They skidded to a stop at the intersection and blocked Han Xiao's path. The wheels splashed up the puddles of water as they moved in an arc, facing Han Xiao from the side.

Large caliber guns extended out of the car windows and opened fire at the same time. The flames from the guns were about half a meter long.

The bullets expanded in his vision, and Han Xiao was hit head-on. These guns were all large caliber submachine guns. There were also a few shotguns that had a knockback effect. Even with the protection of his armor, he was still slowed down by the kinetic energy of the bullets, and sparks flew everywhere.

A new information appeared on the interface. The identity of the enemy was that of the Special Forces of Ordina.

Han Xiao hurriedly changed his direction. His skateboard shoes stepped on the buildings on the side of the street and slid past the roofs of two RVs. The special forces soldiers in the RVs hurriedly got out of their vehicles and opened fire at him. The bullets chased after his expert figure, leaving a row of dense bullet holes on the outer walls of the buildings. Han Xiao took out an explosive grenade, opened the ring with his mouth, and threw it into the middle of the RV. The special forces hurriedly dodged, but the sound wave of the grenade ignored all obstacles. The buzzing sound spread, and the special forces were knocked out on the spot. Han Xiao turned around, shot the tires of the RV, and left.

The surveillance cameras along the way were destroyed by Han Xiao's bullets, but the agents continued to chase after him. Some even took a detour to block his path. In terms of speed, the Electromagnetic Hover-boots were not as fast as these speeding cars. Han Xiao did not choose to take the main road. The Electromagnetic Hover-boots could ignore all obstacles, and he could jump over walls and buildings to shake off the pursuers again and again. However, there was always a new car in front of him. Ordina had placed a lot of manpower in these few streets.

How can they always find me? Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration. He looked back as he slid and saw three unmanned aerial drones in the sky. No wonder the enemy could always follow him. He took out the Red Falcon and destroyed the drones with three shots.

The commander of the Ordina operation was so angry that he slammed the table. The other team had lost the seller, and now Han Xiao was the last target. However, the enemy was too difficult to deal with, and the men they had placed couldn't do anything to him.

"Mag, take him down!"

…

After shaking off the last few vehicles, Han Xiao jumped between the buildings. Just as he was about to find a hidden place to change his face and equipment, a spray of bullets suddenly shot out from above and hit him in the back. The small bullets exploded, and thick smoke and flames burst out.

Han Xiao was directly blown into the wall. Dust and bricks were scattered all over the ground.

The close-range explosion made Han Xiao's ears ring a little. He frowned, shook off the dust on his head, and looked up. A figure was standing on the rooftop, wearing a bulletproof vest. His whole body was covered with waterproof bullet belts, and all kinds of guns were hanging on his body. There were four pistols on his waist and thighs, a sniper rifle, and two different assault rifles hanging on his back. He was holding a shotgun in his hand, and smoke was coming out of the muzzle.

The damage of this shot was beyond the attributes of a normal gun. Han Xiao looked at the interface and was shocked.

A Cannon Master?

You have entered combat mode. You have received the following information:
